top_signals.title: Farm Machinery Firms Plunge as US Examines Market Practices
top_signals.summary: Shares of Deere & Co. and other farm equipment manufacturers plunged after the Federal Trade Commission and US Department of Agriculture launched an inquiry into market practices, including potential anticompetitive conduct.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Trillions are being ‘wasted’ on the AI boom, Arthur Hayes says. He’s betting on what comes next
top_signals.summary: Former BitMEX CEO Arthur Hayes says the AI infrastructure boom is being overbuilt and is betting an eventual crash and bailout will send crypto higher.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Boots Sold for $8.9B As Canada’s Westons Re-Enter UK
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Liana Baker joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." The Canadian branch of the billionaire Weston family agreed to buy health retailer Boots for $8.9 billion including debt, in another change of hands for the pharmacy chain and a UK return for the former Selfridges owner. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
